prompt:

Hard late-morning sunlight from the upper left casts a crisp, soft-edged diagonal window-light shadow across one corner of the frame.
The sheet is an AI opportunity map, a ranked table of use cases sorted into groups, built in AI & Agents Advanced. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Build now · 3"; "Build after governance · 5"; "Parked · 4". One small tomato red-orange (#F2552C) printed highlight on the "Build now · 3" group.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Calm, minimal, high-end print photography with natural paper texture.
